finished in 13h and i took my time. probably best vr game that i have played. the polish is so good. for example throwing stuff works as you expect, there are some vr games where throwing things is to wacky and just feels wrong. i loved gunfights because with teleportation movement you teleport behind cover and you duck and peek when shooting. it really makes you feel like in a gunfight. compare that to boneworks, where you can just move and ducking and peeking really is not needed. i know you can change the settings so you can do it here, but i really felt like this was good. also playing for 4h straight does not make you sick that way, but this might be only my problem. the game itself is more horror focus than other half life series games so be prepared for that. i usually dislike horror games but this game really didnt have cheap jumpscares which i liked. the lore is also somewhat expanded and you get to see the eastern europe much more. it is really fun just to explore the world and read the newspapers. if you have live in eastern europe then you will probably recognise a lot of stuff here, from cars to household items. right now there isnt a lot of replay value but more mods are coming out so thats only good for the longevity for this game.

the graphics models and textures are decent, it's clear they cut corners to keep the size down. the worst part is that the visual quality is really bad in some of the worlds - red savanna and orange sunset are completely useless. you can't see anything due to the poor lighting. in red savanna you can turn on daylight mode which helps a lot. green meadows is the best with the most to see. red fall is similar. blue moon is kind of interesting, but since it's dark it's not easy to see things. you can turn on daylight mode which makes it look dusk. the only real interactivity you have with the environment is when you press the a or x button and display the ring of effects you can grab and throw. these include rain, butterflys, animal attractor, trees, and flowers. you can walk up to certain bushes and break off branches and birds will land on them right in front of you. that's kinda cool the first time. depending on the environment there are a few other choices. for instance in deep blue you can throw fish, and in outer space you can throw around planets, comets, and stars, etc. overall it's a decent vr demo, but not something that will keep most people coming back due to the experience getting stale quickly.
